Messages.Author: Bjoern Meyer
Messages.Body:
Lets say i play the Dodge card in the first round of combat and use it as 
a strike what happens if my opponent plays a press and a second round 
occurs. Could i use the dodge again? I ask because on the card it is 
said, that i'm only allowed to replace it at the end of the combat, so 
could i use such cards in additional combat rounds, or are they only 
usable in the round in which they are played, but i'm only not allowed to 
replace them??????

Thank you for your answers!
<bjoern.meyer@student.uni-tuebingen.de>

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Bjoern Meyer  <zxmil05@hp17.zdv.uni-tuebingen.de> wrote:
>Lets say i play the Dodge card in the first round of combat and use it as 
>a strike what happens if my opponent plays a press and a second round 
>occurs. Could i use the dodge again?...

Strikes are only used once.  They don't last until the next round, or
even until additional strikes.  To keep dodging you would have to play
more strike: dodge cards.

Messages.Body:

: Thank you for your answers!
: <bjoern.meyer@student.uni-tuebingen.de>

My understanding is that unless a card *specifically* says it can be used 
more than once, it is discarded after use.  Only cards that say something 
to the effect of "this combat" or "until end of turn" or some such can be 
used multiply

> 
> My understanding is that unless a card *specifically* says it can be used 
> more than once, it is discarded after use.  Only cards that say something 
> to the effect of "this combat" or "until end of turn" or some such can be 
> used multiply

That's correct.  The "don't replace" means that you can't draw an additional 
card during that combat.  The penalty for the dodge is that you are one card
short for the rest of the combat.  It is still a one shot dodge.
